answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, released only after three unrelated confirmations, rewards vest against future work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Work waits on the atlas until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the basalt of the next round. By the gale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
